citations.cites: E-22 - Damage to metal roof surfacing consisting solely of denting, without loss of water-shedding function
Scope of endorsement covering exclusions E-21 and E-22 for hail loss

facts: Roof is standing-seam metal with numerous hail dents across the south and west panels.
Inspection found no punctures, no leaks in the attic, and panels continue to shed water normally.
Roofer quote to replace the panels is $19,800.
note: The loss involves denting of a metal roof surfacing caused by hail, with no loss of water‑shedding function, which triggers exclusion E‑22 that expressly excludes such denting damage. The endorsement scope (E‑21 and E‑22) applies to hail losses on the loss date. [HO-0415_01-24#05] [HO-0415_01-24#03]
